hero_lede: Auto repair done right. Call and we will take a look.

quote_h2: Tell us what is going on with the car
footer_blurb: Solis Tire Auto Services serving Zebulon.
about_p1: We handle auto repair for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers diagnostics and engine work, tires and wheels, exhaust and underbody. We work out of Zebulon and the towns around it.
area_h2: We work in and around Zebulon

reviews.author: Leal Pavers LLC
reviews.text: I had to fix the sensor valve that was leaking air. They helped me quickly and I was able to continue my going. Great service and friendly staff. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Derek Barbour
reviews.text: Friendly staff, excellent prices. I would highly recommend them If you're In need of any kind of tire services.

reviews.author: Mitchell Wood
reviews.text: Awesome guys that take care of your vehicle needs including RVs. 10 out of 10 on service, time, cost, and very friendly.

reviews.author: Falan Harris
reviews.text: Absolutely Amazing service!!! I went on a Saturday. All the tire places were closed around me and when I walked in the office I asked are y'all open cause the website said closed on Saturday. He said respectfully ma'am we closed an hour ago. I said ok thank you as I walked out the door he said let me see your tires. I told him I was going on a trip to VA and wanted to see if I could wait to get a tire when I got bk. He said absolutely not both front tires are very bad, which I knew the tread was gone on both just not sure if it was too bad. He said go to the bk now and we'll get you a set of front tires. Took about 15 min him and another employee on each side of the car. They were so fast, respectful and caring. Please go to them. They are very honest workers

reviews.author: Arlanda MILES
reviews.text: They are the perfect gentleman always! Plus the prices are unbearable! I was in and out within 35 minutes..

reviews.author: Terri Mangrum
reviews.text: Had tires mounted and balanced and a front end alignment. The price was unbelievable. Will definitely go back when I need tire service again.

reviews.author: River Tam
reviews.text: I had a tire blow out so I put the spare donut on the car and drove to their shop....they had an awesome selection of used tires and had me back on the road with practically brand new tires for the price that would have cost me to get one anywhere else! Fast, and professional. A+service!!! Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: River Tam
reviews.text: I had a blowout and after putting donut on I called them ... they had the size tire I needed even got me back on the in a matter of minutes... It was great I didn't even have to get out of the car I just drove onto the lift and they did the rest I highly recommend, reasonable prices, they're quick and efficient, professional, and very helpful.

reviews.author: Mason Perry
reviews.text: One of the best tire shops around especially for a business owner. Solis tire is always ready to take care of us when needed and always has handled my repairs in a day. Cannot recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Michael Herberger
reviews.text: I needed an alignment and expected to schedule something in the future, but they said I could come on over. I was in and out in less than 30 minutes. The gentleman was very friendly. I got exactly the service I needed with my busy schedule. Would definitely recommend. Other local competitors wouldn’t align my 4 runner so I’m glad they were recommended!

reviews.author: Preston Hubble
reviews.text: This business and the folks I interacted with are fabulous! I got a flat on the highway passing through the area on the way to the beach and found Solis. They took us in quickly, found the leak and had us back on the road in less than 90 minutes. The people who helped us were pleasant to talk to and very professional. They did what they promised for a wonderful price! Isn’t that what a great business does?!

reviews.author: Linda Myers
reviews.text: Very honest, my go to shop for alignments! They show you everyhing and explain repairs clearly and honestly, at a great price! My car has been riding straight as an arrow!

reviews.author: Sholonda Hawley
reviews.text: Rude. The Alignment service might be good. Definitely don’t get used tires from there, if so check them thoroughly. They have holes and nails in them and if you don’t catch it they definitely won’t tell you.

reviews.author: Mikeriah Lassiter
reviews.text: Everyone was very welcoming and got to me right away. I came in with a nail in my tire and was able to get it fixed for a very reasonable price and it did not take long either! I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Bravette Chrisp Jr
reviews.text: Welcoming atmosphere and best prices hands down. Prompt service as well My brakes needed repairs and they fixed them pronto no hassle Highly recommend their service.

reviews.author: Justin Carpenter
reviews.text: The customer service at this tire shop is absolutely excellent. I highly reccomend it to anyone. They talk with you right away and are very efficient and smart about what they do. They even know which vehicles have air pressure sensors and are sure to not cause any damage to your rims or caps. They put everything back the way it belongs and are some of the most understanding people I've met. I give this place an A+ and will be giving them more business. Thank You guys!!!

reviews.author: Lexi Mercer
reviews.text: Really appreciate the team at Solis for all of their help! Had a nail in my tire on my commute and they were able to patch and repair quickly. Great customer service, especially with me coming right at closing. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lance Cook
reviews.text: Amazing service and lowest price tire's around. The owner cares more about making the customer happy than overcharging everyone. I've bought 3 new seta of tires and been extremely happy with everything. They also offer quality used tires.

reviews.author: David Husbands
reviews.text: Top notch service! We had two blowouts on a camper on the way to the Outer Banks on a Friday night right before spring break. We contacted Solis Tire 10 minutes before closing and from the initial call, we were treated with kindness throughout the process. Gestapo came to our rescue on the side of I-40 with two new tires and we were on our way in under an hour! He never complained or acted as if we were an inconvenience or interruption to his Friday evening. He could have easily said that they were closing and we could come back in the morning, but he took the time to serve a family in need! I would highly recommend this company and will use them again if I find myself in the Zebulon area!

reviews.author: eduardo ramirez
reviews.text: Great prices and the guys here really know what they are doing. Place has been here for years and I would never take my tire problems anywhere else but here.

reviews.author: princess sky Luna
reviews.text: I have used this place previously about a year ago and no problem with getting a reliable tire, plus I try to support minority businesses. Well never again will I use this place for tires(new), because there is no warranty. After using this place once again less than a week ago spending about 170$ for a brand new tire which was literally driven one day and it popped went back to see about getting it replaced and they basically told me I had to buy another tire. So be sure to check and see if they have a warranty on the tire before purchasing.

reviews.author: Cheryl Johnson
reviews.text: Went to get tires for my husband car. They were quick, efficient and friendly. Would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Casey Bogli (His Goddess)
reviews.text: Gustavo the own n his wife are very nice people yes they have a business but when they see someone in need they help!. I went in to price a tire my mom n me, we didn't have the $ till next Friday but he went a head and put the tire on our car because we had wires showing and the tire was about to blowout. We want to thank you again Gustavo for your kindness and help.

reviews.author: Barbara Woods
reviews.text: Very fast service with fantastic prices. They installed the two tires I brought with me which was the selling point for me since shops like this are getting harder to find. Most places will only install tires that you buy from them, but Solis Tire didn't hesitate at all.

reviews.author: bamlvr01
reviews.text: Called them up and they were super nice. Abd gave me the exact price with tax that i would pay right then. Even though he seemed busy he multitasked so well and was so cool about it. I would come here for more needs in the future. Very happy.

reviews.author: Adams Pest Solutions
reviews.text: I called at 8am and was quoted a price. I asked what was the latest I could get there to get tires. I was riding on prayers, my tires were bad. He said just get here by 5pm. I was there by 4:40pm and the job was completed before 5:30pm (now that is fast work). I got 4 used tires that look brand new for $150.15. I would never had been able to get tires for that price anywhere else. You now have my business for good. Thank you!

reviews.author: Anthony Crawford
reviews.text: GOD BLESS THESE PEOPLE AND THEIR BUSINESS!!!! They helped me out in a very difficult situation, after having the worst day I've had in a long time. I was traveling and had a complete blowout on my utility trailer. They replaced my spare tire and had me out the door in literally 10 minutes. I don't live near Zebulon, but if I did, I'd gladly do business with these folks all the time. Well done Solis Tire & Auto Service! That's what "customer service" looks like!

reviews.author: Jay H
reviews.text: This is a wonderful place. We had an auto accident on Highway 64 and needed a tow and two tires. Since we did not know the area, we just called the first place after an online search. They were very helpful. They got us a tow to there location and made sure we were comfortable during the repair of our auto.

reviews.author: Brittany Alexander
reviews.text: They were fantastic. I woke up to a flat tire in my driveway. My husband put the spare on and we drove here. They were quick and very kind. Matched the new tire to my existing ones, balanced and I was gone in 30 mins flat. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Jason Holmes
reviews.text: Spend $1000+ on a new set of tires or get some used ones for 1/4 the price. I usually get around 60k miles from their tires. It's a good deal if you don't mind used tires. Once I tried used tires once I never paid full price again. Solis has great deals. Stop by and check them out.

reviews.author: C El
reviews.text: Awesome staff and services. Fixed my problem right away and no confusion. No surprises. Gentleman removed and replaced my existing damaged lug nuts. Highly Recommend.

reviews.author: Kaylee Sanchez
reviews.text: I don’t recommend this place. They are very racist. My fiancé who drove all the way to Zebulon looking for some tires this morning asked for the pricing, and the employee shouts, “white boy needs tires” and then made a slick comment saying “this is a Mexican tire place not a white boys tire place, we don’t serve you” and other disrespect comments. Just because of his skin color, doesn’t mean he isn’t Spanish or speaks Spanish. This is unacceptable and unprofessional. This company needs to learn some respect. We’re definitely never coming here again!

reviews.author: Spruzle Berries
reviews.text: It's exactly what it looks like... A cheaper, local alternative to places like Discount Tire. With that said, some standard practices aren't met here (blocking the car before lifting it, using a torque wrench to get and accurate final torque on wheel lugs) so if you're a freak about the details then this place might not be you best option. But the guys I interacted with were plenty friendly and helpful, and I can't complain about the value either.

reviews.author: Kevin Harris
reviews.text: Gustavo is the man! He's got the best alignment machine anywhere around and takes the time to get it right. Also the most reasonable on pricing for tires in the area.

reviews.author: Timothy Noe
reviews.text: Only shop in the area that had my tire size after a blowout. Gustavo welcomed me kindly, and his staff promptly and efficiently changed my tire as I arrived. They even included a new air cap!

reviews.author: dis guy
reviews.text: There are a lot of local businesses that show the character and professionalism that is growing the town of Zebulon. Solis Tire is leading the way for future business to follow. I can not say enough about the personal care the staff shows everyone who comes in. I highly recommend Solis Tire for all your needs. I will not go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Heather Alwran
reviews.text: Solis tire is the absolute best tire shop I have ever been to. Do yourself a favor quit overpaying at just tires! Visit Solis! Fast and such great work!

reviews.author: Christopher Bilbao
reviews.text: Awesome shop. They quickly got my 3 tires patched up. Definitely returning for tire and alignment needs

reviews.author: Jonathan Collins
reviews.text: Quickly changed my tires and Sol even set my mind at ease by resetting my tire light right then and there b4 I left. If you have any tire issue or want quick service, go here!

reviews.author: Ron N
reviews.text: Damaged my car working on it and would not make it right. They didn’t give a crap about anything but getting paid for the work they did, and when I told them the damage was more than the bill I owed I was told either pay or leave without my car. May have been a different outcome if the owner had been there. Stay away from here.

reviews.author: Tambone
reviews.text: No matter how busy Mr. Solis is he always takes time for his customers. We have bought many tires here and always feel like we're getting a square deal.

reviews.author: Alex Pineda
reviews.text: I bought 1 trailer tire and they didn't double checked and I ended up having flat tire when I was driving to work but I've called the owner and he agreed to fix my tire so happy end for me finally lol.

reviews.author: Glenn S
reviews.text: Been going here for several years. He always fits you in and today gave me a good price on 4 trailer tires. Shop local!!

reviews.author: Auro
reviews.text: Always get my tires looked at and get good reasonable prices here. I just got 2 used tires for around $80. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Ruffin Denton
reviews.text: Super hard working guys. Everyone is very nice and eager to help. No matter what service you go in for, you will leave smiling. Thanks guys

reviews.author: Ameer Khan
reviews.text: Really nice people, and fixed my tire quickly...told me the options and helped me make the best decision for my car.

reviews.author: Beth Marshburn
reviews.text: Been using them for years!!! Always helpful have sent my children there over the years always felt good about receiving good quality affordable service.

reviews.author: Luis Hiram Torres-Alvarez
reviews.text: The service was excellent and fast. Gustavo Solis owner was courteous, attentive, helpful and provided me the best options available. I recommend it.

reviews.author: Vivian Nehrenz
reviews.text: We have been going to Solis tire for all our dump truck tires for years. Great service and competitive tires. I recommend solis tire highly!

reviews.author: William Hubbard
reviews.text: Excellent customer service quick and reasonably priced. Great for someone from out of town. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Melanie Haynes
reviews.text: They helped me tremendously last week with my tire. Gave me a recommendation for a part, and I recommend them highly!

reviews.author: Randy Parnell
reviews.text: They do an excellent job on everything from a lawn mower to an 18-wheeler tire. Great prices and friendly service!

reviews.author: RUSTY WHEELER
reviews.text: The staff, from the phone call before to check stock to the very last moment before I left, was polite, honest, and professional. I always recommend this place whenever asked.

reviews.author: brendan/ / /
reviews.text: FRIENDLY, FAST, CONVENIENT, PROFESSIONAL, GOOD PRICES. Don't waste ur time going anywhere else for tires

reviews.author: Peter L
reviews.text: I needed a tire repair with a piece of metal in it. They took care of the problem right away with a great price.

reviews.author: Gabino Mejia
reviews.text: Disappointed that they didn't answer the phone until 8:30 AM. But I know that they provide good service.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: Been here multiple times on various days and nobody is ever here and nobody answers the phone. I don't think they are even in business.

reviews.author: Jeff Shearl
reviews.text: Good service .they do good work and was out of there with 4 tires balanced in an hour as a walk in customer.
